_comentario: MODELO TEENS. Aula 21 = FALA (aula impar) no formato CONVERSA (atualizacao 01/10/2026 do CURRICULO): obrigacao e necessidade no passado (had to / didn't have to / didn't need to / needn't have + participio). E o ponto da antiga aula 17 (have to / don't have to, B1) elevado para B2. Tema bloco G (fazer e vender); fato dono: os bolos que ela vendeu no predio. Video em aula (SciShow Kids, YouTube nocookie). Vozes iguais as aulas 1-20.

lesson.grammar_point: past obligation and necessity: had to, didn't have to / didn't need to, needn't have + past participle

listenings.text: Sophia, it's Ruby! I'm in the kitchen with my mom, and it's a disaster. We had to start the cupcakes again, because the first batch didn't rise. I didn't need to buy more eggs, thank goodness, because my neighbor gave me six. But I made two bowls of frosting, and we only needed one. I needn't have made so much! So, do you want the leftovers? I'll bring them to school tomorrow on a tray.
